May 24, 2018 

Honorable Scott S. Harris 
Clerk of the Supreme Court of the United States 
1 First Street, N.E. 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

RE:   Virginia Uranium, Inc. v. Warren, No. 16-1275 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

Pursuant to Rules 25.5 and 30.4, Petitioners and Respondents in the above-captioned case 

jointly request an extension of time within which to file their respective briefs on the merits.  

The  Writ  of  Certiorari  was  granted  in  this  case  on  May  21,  2018.  Petitioners’  brief  is 
currently due on July 5, and Respondents’ brief is due on August 6. Petitioners request a two-week 
extension of the deadline for their brief on the merits, to and including July 19, and Respondents 
request an additional week extension of the deadline for their brief on the merits, to and including 
August 27. Under this proposed extended schedule, Petitioners’ Reply Brief would be due pursuant 
to  Rule  25.3  on  September  26,  which  would  preserve  the  possibility  that  the  case  could  be 
scheduled for the first sitting of the Court’s October 2018 Term. 

These extensions are jointly requested both because of the many professional commitments 
of  both  Petitioners’  and  Respondents’  Counsel  in  other  cases,  and  because  of  long-scheduled 
vacation plans, over the summer, by Counsel for both parties. 

Respectfully submitted, 

s/ Charles J. Cooper 
Charles J. Cooper 

COOPER & KIRK, PLLC 
Counsel of Record for Petitioners 

s/ Toby J. Heytens 
Toby J. Heytens 

SOLICITOR GENERAL 
OFFICE OF THE ATTORNEY GENERAL 
Counsel of Record for Respondents
